Shiba is run one sample at a time using our snakemake workflow. 
We then merge PSI tables produced for each sample.

## Set up

## Directories and files

```{r define_paths}
# find the project directory
base_dir <- here::here()

# find the root-level repo directory
repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_git_root)

# define the data directories
# shiba pilot results
results_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "results")
target_subset_results_dir <-file.path(results_dir, "target-subset-shiba-output/results")
splice_results_dir <- file.path(target_subset_results_dir, "splicing")

# output directory of results
out_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "splicing_summaries")

# create output directory if it does not already exist
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# define output files

# combined dataframe of PSI values across all quantified splice event types
combined_psi_file <- file.path(out_dir, "combined_psi_results.rds")

# long summary file of the counts of PSI values per PSI value bin (0, 1, 0 < PSI < 1, NA) for each sample, pooled by splice event type (one aggregate count of the number of PSI values in the bin for one splice event type within a sample)
sample_psi_summary_file <- file.path(out_dir, "sample_psi_summary.rds")

# long summary file of the counts of PSI values per PSI value bin (0, 1, 0 < PSI < 1, NA), per individual splicing event
# so the max number of counts per bin possible is the number of samples (88)
pos_id_psi_summary_file <- file.path(out_dir, "pos_id_psi_summary.rds")
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r read_file_paths}
# define list of unzipped PSI results files corresponding to event types quantified by Shiba bulk analysis
psi_files <- c(
  se = "PSI_SE.txt.gz",
  afe = "PSI_AFE.txt.gz",
  ale = "PSI_ALE.txt.gz",
  five = "PSI_FIVE.txt.gz",
  three = "PSI_THREE.txt.gz",
  mse = "PSI_MSE.txt.gz",
  mxe = "PSI_MXE.txt.gz",
  ri = "PSI_RI.txt.gz"
)

# Construct bulk PSI result paths and name them according to event type
bulk_psi_paths <- file.path(splice_results_dir, psi_files)
names(bulk_psi_paths) <- names(psi_files)
```
